heading: Purposes
lead: It is the purpose of this chapter—

tree.text: to establish national standards governing the marketing of certain agricultural products as organically produced products;
to assure consumers that organically produced products meet a consistent standard; and
to facilitate interstate commerce in fresh and processed food that is organically produced.

notes.text: Short TitlePub. L. 101–624, title XXI, § 2101, Nov. 28, 1990, 104 Stat. 3935, provided that: “This title [enacting this chapter] may be cited as the ‘Organic Foods Production Act of 1990’.”
